title: Sparse, even after an hour of futzing with branches. Not at all like photo!
text: Sparse, even after an hour of futzing with branches. Not at all like photo!. I seriously wonder if I was sent the correct tree. Even after futzing for an hour playing with the branches, it looks nothing like the photo. It is very bare. I cannot recommend this tree to anyone. The only redeeming feature of this tree are the lights. I do like the feature where it gently switches to white, to colored, to green white, etc. However, it is difficult to switch lights with the control on the floor and isn't a remote. All around, a disastrous purchase. Learn from my mistake in purchasing - don't unless you want a tree full of holes but good lights hard to reach. I would post a picture of the bare tree I received but I don't know how. Three other people who looked at it said the manufacturer had to have doctored the original picture which looks full and lush, unlike my tree. They also questioned what tree I actually received after looking at the online photo and what I actually received.

product_metadata.title: National Tree Company Pre-Lit 'Feel Real' Artificial Slim Downswept Christmas Tree, Green, Douglas Fir, Dual Color LED Lights, Includes PowerConnect and Stand, 7.5 feet
features: This Downswept Douglas Fir Slim Pre-Lit Artificial Green Christmas Tree is 7.5 feet tall with a 32 inch base diameter. Featuring hundreds of 'Feel Real' individually crafted branch tips to create full bodied branches, this tree is designed to look and feel lifelike.

Features PowerConnect system and 900 Dual Color LED bulbs that can switch between white and multicolor lights. This feature includes a switch to control ten different light functions, allowing the bulbs to twinkle, flash or fade on either color setting.

This tree features pre-attached, hinged branches that drop down for a simple set-up and fold back in for quick and convenient storage. Set aside 45-60 minutes to properly shape the tree by peeling back the branches and pulling the tips apart.
Constructed with sturdy, high quality materials, hypo-allergenic, fire-resistant needles, this tree is built to bring holiday cheer for years to come. Includes a durable metal base.

At National Tree Company, we believe that special holiday memories don’t have to be far and few between. This Christmas season, let our decorations transform your home while you focus on creating more of those magical moments.
description: Transform your home into a winter wonderland with National Tree Company's Pre-Lit ‘Feel Real’ Artificial Christmas Tree. This Downswept Douglas Fir tree is 7.5 feet tall and has a 32 inch diameter base, creating a slimmer profile and making it a better option for those with limited space. Friends and family alike will marvel at how the tree closely mimics those outside. Molded from real tree branches for an authentic living tree appearance, this tree features our trademarked ‘Feel Real’ technology. Hundreds of crush-resistant polyethylene tips form full bodied branches to create a tree with remarkable realism. The tree is designed with a hinged branch system that allows the branches to swing down for a quick and simple set-up and fold back in for easy storage. Set aside 45-60 minutes after assembly to properly shape the tree by peeling back the branches and pulling the tips apart to give the branches a more full-bodied look. This fantastically festive tree is strung with 900 Dual Color LED lights prior to packaging and includes a sturdy, metal base for a more convenient setup. The Dual Color LED bulbs can alternate between white and multicolor lights and includes a switch to control ten different light functions, allowing the bulbs to twinkle, flash or fade on either color setting. The lights operate individually, so if the bulb lens has not been cracked or broken, the light set will continue to illuminate except for any individual bulbs that are not working. This tree also includes PowerConnect, an additional feature where the wires run through the middle pole of the tree, eliminating the need for extension cords and plugs in the branches. Before dressing the tree in twinkling lights and glistening ornaments, consider placing it in a living room or dining area where it can be viewed from multiple angles and does not block any entryways. Constructed with sturdy, high quality materials and hypo-allergenic, fire-resistant needles, this tree is built to bring holiday cheer for years to come. At National Tree Company, we strive to create high quality Christmas decorations to help you transform your home so you can keep making every holiday moment magical.
